question: What expiation is prescribed in the Shiva-hand rite and what exception applies?
premises: The Shiva-hand rite formerly enjoined recitation of a weapon mantra.
Reciting it a hundred times brings freedom from fault.
The killing of a woman is explicitly excluded from this remedy.
inference: Mantric recitation can expiate many faults, but some transgressions are treated as beyond this ordinary remedy.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the weapon mantra is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: In the rite called Shiva-hand, it was formerly enjoined that by reciting this weapon mantra a hundred times one is freed, except in the case of killing a woman.
